name: Reliable Tech Park: site-detail models
frame: rtp_local metres (x east, y north from the Maps pin 19.1692159 N 73.0017703 E, z up). The GLB is glTF Y-up: three.js (x, y, z) = rtp_local (x, z, -y), same as twin/web/models/exterior/*.glb. Not recentred. Ground level (z 0) is the twin's site ground (11.56 m above sea level).
loading: GLTFLoader with setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder). Repeated props (palms, lamps, bollards) arrive as EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing (InstancedMesh); extras.instance_names lists each instance, and the 'instance_sets' below give their positions. Every node carries extras {group, what, photos, estimated, default_visible}.
honesty: Every size and most positions here are ESTIMATES read from public photos (reference/MODEL_NOTES.md: people, cars, lanes and the model's 3.6 m floor height). None come from drawings or a site survey. Positions anchored on data: the building outline (twin/web/plate.json), the access-road and gate-lane lines (OSM/Overture via review/context_overture.json and demo/data/route.json), the Street View pano positions (reference/site/INDEX.md), the Overture playground polygon (turf box) and the twin's drum_west centre (CLARIANT). Treat everything as 'indicative, to be checked on site'.
brand_marks: site_sign_reliable_letters and site_sign_R_box carry the landlord's marks (RELIABLE, R); site_sign_clariant carries a tenant's mark and is hidden by default. Whether these may appear in client material is open question 3 in EXTERIOR_PLAN.md. The R is plain Times New Roman Bold in a navy box: the real logo's red swoosh and the Reliable Cloud City cloud logo on the gates are deliberately not reproduced. Tenant-board names and the Hotel Mumbai House sign are not reproduced.
night: Materials with extras.emit_night: multiply emissiveIntensity by that factor at night (sign letters x14, R box white x9, globe lamps x24, LED heads x20, soffit downlights x8, tenant board x8, tube lights under the podium x8). The GLB has no lights; add point/spot lights in the viewer if wanted (the check renders used point lights at the canopy downlights, every second wall globe, the pole lamps and the podium tubes).

gate.what: Main gate porte-cochere: two flat canopies with coffered soffit and downlights, bronze ACP fascia, two clad security cabins, central charcoal pier over a white-framed booth, black MS sliding gates (shown open), red planter island with a date palm and 10 globe bollards, blue tenant board, gate apron with hatched crossings and stop lines.
gate.placement: Street View pano (-20,-24) of photo 16 read as standing in the IN lane 3.5 m in front of the canopy; OSM IN/OUT lane junctions; access road line. Canopy front centre (-14.44,-22.73), front at bearing 115 deg, lanes at 25 deg. Position good to a few metres only. All sizes estimated from photos (people, cars, lanes); MODEL_NOTES item 1 range 22-30 m wide x 12-18 m deep, built 30 x 14 m.

wall.what: Boundary wall along the access road: rendered plinth, rendered piers at ~3 m with caps and globe lamps, black MS railing, red-painted kerb on the road side.
wall.placement: 5.0 m north of the OSM/Overture access-road centreline (just behind the twin's footpath), from the gate cabins east to x = 50 and west to x = -38 (where the next campus road enters). Extent and offset estimated.

signage.what: Rooftop signs: red RELIABLE channel letters on a steel frame along the roof edge of the east arm's rounded south end, the navy R box with a white R on a lattice tower behind them (both lit at night), and white CLARIANT letters on a frame on top of the north arm's west drum.
signage.placement: South-end centre ~(29.0, 0.3), roof edge r ~14.5 m, sign facing bearing 220 deg (photo 02 from the south-west). CLARIANT on the twin's drum_west (-39.74, 99.81, top +42.6 m) facing 215 deg. Letter heights 2.0 m and 1.5 m, R box 4 x 4 m: estimates.

podium.what: Raised podium deck along the court faces of both arms: 0.6 m RCC slab at +4.5 m, 2.2 m deep weathered concrete edge beam and parapet, steel railing, planter strip with a palm row, hanging creeper curtains, open parking below with red stamped floor, 0.6 m columns with black-yellow hazard bands, tube lights.
podium.placement: East strip x 1.0 to the east arm's court face, y -4 to 48; north strip y 72.5 to the north arm's court face, x -44 to -1. Deck edges follow plate.json 'outer'. Depth, extent and heights estimated (MODEL_NOTES item 3: deck +4.5 m, parapet 1.1 m, depth 12-15 m).

lobby.what: Lobby entrance: curved glass canopy on steel ribs and two round columns at the chamfered inner corner, paved forecourt / drop-off with black-yellow kerbs, steel bollards, two palms in red planters, steps up to the ground-floor level (+0.6 m).
lobby.placement: On the twin's lobby chamfer (6.48,82.84)-(15.53,73.79), which is itself a modelling assumption (exterior/NOTES.md). Canopy 12 x 7 m, 6.4 m high at the facade: estimated.

court.what: Court: netted artificial-turf sports box with galvanised posts, side and roof nets, kickboard, goals, markings and two flood-light poles, on a paved surround of grey interlocking pavers; paved walkways along the podium fronts with campus pole lamps.
court.placement: Turf box on the Overture 'recreation/playground' polygon (-29.6,70.8)(-31.2,53.7)(6.7,50.0)(7.6,69.4), rotated -3.9 deg; box 32 x 15 m (MODEL_NOTES item 4: 30 x 15 m +-25 %). Built at grade; photo 37 suggests it may sit at podium level, not confirmed.

south_end.what: Planting bed round the east arm's south end: red rendered planter kerbs, ground cover, three fan palms, an araucaria and garden globe lamps.
south_end.placement: Arc 3 m wide at 16-19 m from the south-end centre (29.0, 0.0), bearings 110-245 deg. Estimated.

Campus pole lamp, single arm, 7 m, LED head

twin_overrides.why: The site details replace or collide with some objects in the twin's exterior GLBs. Hide these in the viewer when rtp_site_details.glb is shown. Names are node names in twin/web/models/exterior/rtp_building.glb (signs) and instance names in rtp_context.glb (props: look them up in each instanced node's extras.instance_names and set that instance's scale to 0).
cannot_be_separated: rtp_L00_lobby in rtp_building.glb includes the twin's flat ACP lobby canopy (+4.8 to 5.1 m). The curved glass canopy here sits above it (+5.5 to 6.4 m); both show until the twin's canopy is split out by the twin's owner.
rtp_ROOF_dome sits on the south drum in the twin. The photos put the dome over the court-side bulge of the east arm (MODEL_NOTES item 6). Not changed here: it belongs to the twin's build.
The twin's lawn, parking bays and court cars stay; the turf box and the podium sit on top of them. Cars under the podium decks are kept because the photos show parking there.

not_modelled.B Wing signage: No B Wing sign was found in any photo or Street View (reference/site/INDEX.md). Nothing invented.
not_modelled.Neighbour car-park tower (MODEL_NOTES it: Its position is inferred from photos only (north / north-west) and its estimated 65-70 m height disagrees with the open-data heights of the candidate footprints (Empire Tower: Overture DSM excess 37 m). Placing it would invent a building, so it is left to the twin until a site visit or the satellite check settles which footprint it is.
not_modelled.Pylons, switchyard, transformer yard: Positions need OSM power data or the satellite view (MODEL_NOTES item 16).
not_modelled.Water features and sculptures: Pool, dandelion fountain and the three-figure sculpture: positions unknown, and the fountain may be gone (photo from 2018).
not_modelled.Roof drum crenellations, stepped Clarian: Those are changes to the twin's building mesh, owned by the twin build (MODEL_NOTES items 5, 7, 8).
